items.docs: Retrieve a list of user objects. By default, only a limited set of properties are returned. To return an alternative property set, specify the desired properties using the OData $select query parameter.

Create a new user object. The request body contains the user to create. At a minimum, you must specify the required properties for the user, including displayName, mailNickname, userPrincipalName, and passwordProfile.
